# Planned Limited

> Planned Limited is the UK's independent schedule assurance specialist. We are planning-first, claims-capable and Oracle Primavera Cloud capable, working with contractors, subcontractors and consultancies delivering UK infrastructure. Our work covers Primavera P6 and Oracle Primavera Cloud, NEC4 programme compliance, schedule assurance, delay and extension of time analysis, project controls and training.

Company number 08881845, registered in England and Wales. Cyber Essentials certified, APM Corporate Affiliate, Disability Confident Committed. Verifiable details are published at the credentials page below.

## Fixed scope reviews

- [NEC4 Programme Acceptance Review](https://plannedltd.co.uk/reviews/nec4-programme-acceptance-review): independent review of a contractor's programme against clause 31.2, with any recommendation for non-acceptance framed in the language of clause 31.3, delivered inside the contractual reply period.
- [Independent Schedule Assurance Review](https://plannedltd.co.uk/reviews/independent-schedule-assurance-review): full DCMA 14 point assessment plus logic quality and float integrity, with a scored verdict and a fix list.
- [Delay and EOT Position Review](https://plannedltd.co.uk/reviews/delay-and-eot-position-review): a candid assessment of the delay position before committing to a claim.
- [Primavera Migration Readiness Assessment](https://plannedltd.co.uk/reviews/primavera-cloud-migration-readiness-assessment): independent readiness assessment for organisations moving from Microsoft Project, Excel or another planning tool to Primavera P6 or Oracle Primavera Cloud: which platform fits, what converts, what to rebuild, standards and training.
- [All fixed scope reviews](https://plannedltd.co.uk/reviews/)

## Services

- [Project planning and scheduling](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/project-planning): programme development and maintenance in Primavera P6 and Oracle Primavera Cloud, baseline development, critical path analysis, schedule health checks and programme recovery.
- [Project controls](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/project-controls): schedule monitoring, earned value management, change control and performance reporting.
- [Risk analysis](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/risk-analysis): quantitative schedule risk analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, risk registers and response planning.
- [Resource management](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/resource-management): resource loading, levelling, allocation and capacity planning.
- [Primavera P6 administration](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/p6-administration): enterprise implementation, configuration, database consolidation, cloud migration, security and ongoing administration.
- [Oracle Primavera Cloud consultancy](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/oracle-primavera-cloud-consultant): OPC implementation, migration from P6 and team enablement.
- [Primavera P6 consultancy](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/primavera-p6-consultant): hands-on P6 planning and scheduling support.
- [Training](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services/training): instructor-led Primavera P6 and Oracle Primavera Cloud courses from fundamentals to advanced, delivered remotely or on site.
- [All services](https://plannedltd.co.uk/services)

## Free tools

- [Schedule Health Check](https://plannedltd.co.uk/tools/schedule-health-check): a free browser-based tool that runs the full DCMA 14 point assessment and returns an A to F grade with the failing activities named. It accepts Primavera P6 .xer, Primavera P6 XML and Microsoft Project XML files. It reports logic, leads, lags, relationship types, hard constraints, high float, negative float, high duration, invalid dates, resources, missed tasks, the critical path test, CPLI and BEI, and it marks any check it cannot compute from the file as not assessable rather than passing it silently. It also shows the total float distribution and traces the critical path. All analysis runs client-side and no file is uploaded to any server.
